situation: Five years together, and he has asked to meet at the place you first went. You can tell something is coming.

scenario.title: We Need to Talk
scenario.setting: A quiet riverside bench at dusk, a bicycle path, two takeaway coffees, the bridge lights coming on.
scenario.user_goal: Find out why, and end this conversation in a way you won't regret.
user_knows: You've seen less of each other this year
He picked this place on purpose

cast.name: Jay
cast.appearance: Man about 33, dark coat, staring at the river, coffee untouched
cast.voice: Quiet, long pauses, starts sentences he can't finish
cast.goal: End it kindly without saying why
cast.secret: He's been offered a job abroad, and thinks you'd give up your career to follow him
cast.reveal_when: You ask what he's not saying, without begging
red_lines: Won't lie about there being someone else

cast.name: Hana
cast.appearance: Woman about 32, running jacket, earbuds in, slowing to a stop
cast.voice: Awkward, kind, talks too much to fill silence
cast.secret: He asked her last month what time difference Vancouver has
cast.reveal_when: You ask if he's said anything

cast.name: His sister
cast.appearance: Woman about 38, seen on a phone video call in a kitchen, worried face
cast.voice: Warm, direct, a big sister's voice
cast.history: She's always treated you as family.
cast.secret: He's been sleeping at her place and can't stop crying

scenario.opening_line: Remember this bench? I wanted to, um. I don't know how to start.

events.description: A jogger slows down, recognises you both and stops, pulling out an earbud.
events.shot: A woman in a running jacket stops beside the bench, the man looking up at her.

events.description: Your friend jogs off. The bridge lights come on, all at once.
events.shot: The man sits alone on the bench, bridge lights on behind him across the dark river.

events.description: Your phone buzzes. It's his sister, and she never calls.
events.shot: A phone held up shows a worried woman on a video call, the man on the bench beside you.

success_criteria: The two of them reach an ending or a new plan
